timeline.summary: Sanjay Aggarwal, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on shares held by him or persons acting in concert for FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
Paramount Communications approved a preferential issue of equity shares and warrants aggregating ₹122.64 crore and appointed Ms. Rashi Goel as Company Secretary.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹573.31 Cr (+13.1% YoY), net profit ₹20.52 Cr (+9.5% YoY).
Paramount Communications held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15-20% revenue growth in FY27 and outlining plans for the ₹300 Cr Narmadapuram greenfield project.
Sanjay Aggarwal, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on shares held by him or persons acting in concert for FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
Paramount Communications held its Extraordinary General Meeting on June 6, 2026, for preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹560.4 Cr (+30.9% YoY), net profit ₹24.24 Cr (+82.9% YoY).
Paramount Communications released its investor presentation for Q2/H1 FY27 detailing financial performance and expansion plans.
Link to audio recording of the conference call on Un‑Audited Financial Results of the Second Quarter ended 30 September 2026, held 27 October 2026.
